title: Proposed security policy defaults
description: Reversible security policy proposals, not latency budgets or evidence of deployed controls. R11/R13 review before release; OTP-only customer ASVS L2 decision remains unresolved. Cross-field invariant: idle lifetime <= absolute lifetime, step-up lifetime <= privileged idle lifetime, all rate windows shared across replicas. No actual legal requirement is inferred.

entries.rationale: Random numeric challenge balances entry effort and guessing space; never sequential.
entries.verification: CSPRNG generation and format check; accept Persian digit input only through explicit normalization.

entries.rationale: Short-lived proposed challenge; expiry uses injected server clock.
entries.verification: Reject at expiry boundary even if resend/read replicas lag.

entries.rationale: Bound guessing without permanent account lockout.
entries.verification: Fifth failure consumes challenge; fresh challenge still obeys aggregate limits.

entries.rationale: Limit messaging abuse and duplicate codes.
entries.verification: Concurrent resends across replicas create at most one new challenge; invalidate prior code.

entries.rationale: Bound one account-targeted SMS abuse; support recovery stays available.
entries.verification: Sixth request gives generic safe response and no provider send.

entries.rationale: Additional nonidentity abuse control with privacy review.
entries.verification: Shared device limit enforced without revealing account existence.

entries.rationale: Provisional coarse network cap; shared-network accessibility requires monitored tuning.
entries.verification: Concurrent nodes cannot exceed global bucket; approved assisted recovery is offered.

entries.rationale: Limit unattended customer access; warning permits accessible reauthentication.
entries.verification: Expired session denied on API and client clears private content.

entries.rationale: Bound total customer session lifetime even with activity.
entries.verification: Refresh cannot extend beyond original absolute expiry.

entries.rationale: Allow normal devices while making sessions manageable.
entries.verification: New login beyond cap requires user choice to revoke existing session, never silent takeover.

entries.rationale: Shorter idle exposure for staff/finance/provider administration.
entries.verification: Background polling does not count as user activity.

entries.rationale: Bound one working-session duration before full authentication.
entries.verification: Refresh and organization switch do not reset absolute expiry.

entries.rationale: Limit simultaneous privileged sessions and support explicit revocation.
entries.verification: Third login requires revoking an existing session after authentication.

entries.rationale: Opaque CSPRNG session identifiers; exceeds pinned ASVS minimum.
entries.verification: Statistical uniqueness fixture plus implementation CSPRNG review; tokens never logged.

entries.rationale: Fresh authentication for payout, bank/factor change, replay and live connector/config approval.
entries.verification: Old step-up cannot authorize changed proposal digest or different action.

entries.rationale: Requested privileged MFA; ordinary flags cannot disable it.
entries.verification: All alternative login/recovery routes preserve strength.

entries.rationale: Transport-only session cookie.
entries.verification: Browser receives Secure flag; HTTP request cannot establish a live session.

entries.rationale: Prevent script access to reference session.
entries.verification: Document scripts cannot read session value.

entries.rationale: Supports return navigation while CSRF token/origin validation protects mutations.
entries.verification: Cross-site mutation fails; legitimate payment return requires authoritative verification.

entries.rationale: No phone-only bypass for privileged MFA.
entries.verification: Independent reviewer checks evidence and revokes old sessions before factor reset.

entries.rationale: Identity/health/property evidence excludes active formats and archives.
entries.verification: Extension, magic bytes and parser content agree; unknown MIME rejected.

entries.rationale: Video only for inspection workflows with explicit requirement.
entries.verification: Inspection media receives scanner/transcoding validation; other evidence routes reject video.

entries.rationale: Bulk input uses versioned CSV only initially; no active spreadsheet macros.
entries.verification: Content parser enforces encoding/row/column limits and rejects executable spreadsheet content.

entries.rationale: Proposed document/photo bound below canonical FBytes transport ceiling.
entries.verification: Reject larger body before processing; metadata claim and actual byte count must agree.

entries.rationale: Matches canonical FBytes proposed transport ceiling; larger video needs a separate reviewed streaming contract.
entries.verification: Actual uploaded object cannot exceed grant bound.

entries.rationale: Bound decompression/memory exposure of compressed images.
entries.verification: Header dimensions and decoded dimensions checked in isolated worker.

entries.rationale: Limit case storage abuse; additional evidence requires authorized reviewed extension.
entries.verification: Concurrent uploads reserve file quota transactionally.

entries.rationale: No archive support selected; avoids unsafe extraction and hidden executable content.
entries.verification: ZIP/GZIP/DOCX containers rejected even with misleading MIME/extension.

entries.rationale: Bound unreviewed temporary storage for one subject/context.
entries.verification: Distributed pending-upload quota cannot be exceeded by concurrent grants; expiry releases reservation.
